oswork-terminal.titulo: The manager who masters the terminal: OSWork, command by command

jornada-ia.titulo: From chat to agent: the overview

inicio.titulo: From chat to the terminal: the agent working in your folder
inicio.lead: Open the terminal without fear, install the agent from the official source, set up the folder with rules, save each version with Git, keep keys out of the text, and put your page online. Command by command, with what to check at every step.
inicio.capa_alt: A notebook with the terminal open beside a notepad with a hand-drawn folder tree.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order you’ll do them. Each lesson ends with practice and a short test; move on only when the “done when” condition is met.

itens: People who use ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini in a browser and have never opened a terminal.
People who have seen the program overview and want to complete step 1 for real, with every command.
People who will guide a team or client and need to know how to check what the agent did.

blocos.t: What you’ll be able to do
itens: Navigate folders with cmd (and the Mac or Linux Terminal), always knowing where you are.
Install and sign in to Claude Code or Codex with your subscription, checking the sign-in method.
Set up the agent’s folder with README, AGENTS.md, .env outside Git, and history you can roll back.
Publish the page on GitHub Pages and move the same project to a VPS.
